effects.persistence: continues indefinitely until the door is opened
constraints: Only interior doors are stated to be affected.

evidence.locator: These doors are visually unchanged; however, when a sapient organism comes within 2m of an SCP-1879-1 instance, repeated knocking emanates from the object.

constraints: The door has produced repeated knocking.

evidence.locator: At this point, a male humanoid entity, hereby designated as SCP-1879-2, will emerge from the SCP-1879-1 instance.

constraints: SCP-1879-2 offers and sells a product.

evidence.locator: Said price rarely consists of currency and often is detrimental to the subject or the subject's health.

effects.trigger: if it is sufficiently threatened or wounded
effects.persistence: it later returns within the same house via a different door

evidence.locator: However, if it is sufficiently threatened or wounded, the entity will temporarily retreat back into SCP-1879-1, which will then revert back into a non-anomalous door.
